title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you guys have an announcement in the works about minor league pay?
Is this report from McCosky about what I asked you five hours earlier true?
That you guys will pay minor leaguers $400
With no end date, and no mass cuts
Questioned “Is this report from McCosky about what I asked you five hours earlier true?”
